body:
## Scope
Compiler, builder and linker infrastructure for model-free local use and future Win32IDE/agent tool integration. This PR is intentionally separate from extension PR #72 and based on `fix/deep2-multimodel-safety-20261025`.

## Executable evidence (exact GitHub artifact)
- **37/37 local Python black-box tests PASS**, using actual Clang/GCC, Clang-CL + LLD-Link, CMake+Ninja, PE/COFF validation, ELF execution and negative cases.
- The committed `tools/rawrxd_native_toolchain.py` blob SHA is `1636ca47ccea954712ae9e87e5f1f7469d235158`, byte-identical to the locally tested source.
- The committed `tools/tests/test_native_toolchain.py` blob SHA is `426e9f6619d2b0676c9c1c09ddcd030b9506423f`, byte-identical to the 35 executed tests.
- Real generated Windows x64 PE32+ recognized structurally; Linux host executable invoked and returned expected exit status. Windows GUI/runtime execution **not** claimed.

## Source fixes
- New local, JSON-result CLI for compile/link/build/CMake project/verify, gated by `--approve-mutations`, workspace containment and transactional output promotion. Uses `subprocess.run(argv)` (never a shell), real tool return codes, artifact presence/signature validation and SHA-256.
- Standalone `rawrxd_link` driver now fails instead of skipping unreadable/mismatched COFF files, accepting malformed options, guessing entry RVA 0x1000, or writing beyond a fixed-length map path buffer.
- COFF reader now verifies declared table, raw section, relocation and string-table bounds and refuses truncated data.
- Native relocation resolver now guards write widths, contribution boundaries, RVA arithmetic and signed overflow instead of writing malformed relocations. Added negative relocation-overrun tests; runtime NOT certified.
- Native PE linker/checker added to main CMake build graph as installable `RawrXD-PELinker`/`RawrXD-COFFCheck`. Adapter installed as a separate entry point; its model tool authorization is still EXTERNAL to the script.
- 16 **unexecuted** native-linker COFF-to-PE and negative mutation tests replace a former placeholder CMake target.
- GitHub Actions workflow for Linux/Windows compile-link and own-linker CTest.

## Evidence update
- Latest local rerun: 37 local combined adapter/runner tests in 23.7s, PASS on real compiler/linker toolchain. Git blob hashes independently checked for exact committed source and tests.
- 16 own-linker COFF-to-PE tests are committed but **not executed**; GitHub Actions runner scheduling is blocking CI before any steps.

## Latest tested subprocess and binary-format hardening
- 32/32 compiler adapter tests plus 5/5 subprocess runner tests, **37/37 local runtime PASS**, zero skips, all compiled against the exact GitHub blob bytes. Linux subprocess runner kills descendant process groups on timeout; Windows taskkill /T path remains pending Windows CI.
- Concurrent bounded capture (32 KiB tails, max 16 MiB per stream), explicit timeout/overflow failure, no shell expansion, preserved old output on failure, separate stdout/stderr, packaged CLI cold-start tested.
- Host ELF verifier now distinguishes relocatable object files from linked ET_EXEC/ET_DYN executables; unlinked objects never produce a false success.
- The Python CLI installer now ships its required sibling `rawrxd_process_runner.py` module; CI executes both test suites.

- Extra structural binary acceptance: invalid COFF section/relocation ranges and PE section offsets cannot be falsely accepted as linked outputs. 2 new executable regression tests PASS.
- CI latest run (e.g. https://github.com/ItsMehRAWRXD/RawrXD/actions/runs/42339466791) remains failure before runner assignment: both jobs have empty runner_name and 0 executed steps; NOT a compiler failure and NOT a PASS.

## Not a 100% certification
- Own `rawrxd_link` PE positive integration and MSVC build **NOT EXECUTED** in this container, native linker tests must run on real toolchain to certify.
- No Windows PE execution/CRT/SDK ABI validation; the direct `/nodefaultlib` mode is for freestanding smoke fixtures.
- New adapter not yet registered in the IDE menu or model tool dispatcher; explicit approval must not be inferred from model output.
- Native Win32IDE build, model inference/hot loading, agent tool dispatch, release packaging, T05/T24/T25 remain OPEN.
- Overall IDE historical 68% remains **unrecalculated**. No artificial percentage increase.
- Main development branch is advancing concurrently; reconcile before merge. This is a draft PR, not ready for release.
title: WIP: native compiler, CMake builder and PE/COFF linker acceptance pipeline
